description: A conductor in a black tailcoat, seen from behind, stands on a wooden podium with his arm raised and a baton in hand. He faces a grand gilded auditorium with arched ceilings and several tiers of boxes packed with men in black formal dress and women in long gowns. Below him an orchestra of string players, cellos and a brass section sits on stage, with a choir in dark robes behind them. The lighting is warm and golden, and the image has no visible text, frame or border.
